description: Department Trade and Investment Policy -  Suspend making payments through Outward investment Accounts  - Reserved
categorisation: This gazette content is a legal/regulatory instrument issued under the Foreign Exchange Act, No. 12 of 2017. It contains specific regulatory orders (suspending certain payments, limiting remittances, setting monetary limits) related to foreign exchange transactions. The document is an official order made under statutory authority (Section 22 of the Act) and establishes binding regulatory requirements, making it clearly a Legal/Regulatory Gazette rather than a government personnel or structural matter.
